Class SecurityChartPdfService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.report.pdf.SecurityChartPdfService
@Service public class SecurityChartPdfService extends Object
Makes the PDF of a time-series chart. The browser delivers the picture of the chart and the numbers at its markers; everything that is a statement about the user's data is read here: the transactions are loaded by the same report methods and in the same scope as for the chart, so the table cannot disagree with the markers, and a transaction outside the user's tenant never appears whatever the request names.

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public SecurityChartPdfService.Result generate(Integer idTenant, SecurityChartPdfRequest request, LocalDate today) throws Exception
      Generates the document. Must run on the request thread, because the transaction reports identify the user through the security context.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant of the signed-in user
      request - the chart and what it shows
      today - the day of the user, printed as creation date and used as cutoff of the transactions
